newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against the dollar and pound on Wednesday, reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.1515 against the dollar from 20.0660 on Tuesday. The rupee was posted at a mean of 32.986 against the pound from 32.916 on Tuesday.
Dealers said despite central bank market intervention on Tuesday, the rupee was fixed weaker because of the strong dollar in overseas markets.
They said the central bank sold dollars below the prevailing interbank rate during the Tuesday intervention, but this failed to stop the rupee from weakening.
"Without the central bank's intervention, the rupee would have depreciated by some 10 cents more against the dollar today (Wednesday)," one dealer said.
